high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram sponsored post from the account "anothereyeclothing." The post features a white hoodie with a graphic design on the front. The design includes an eye with a green iris and a heartbeat line extending from it, symbolizing life or energy. The hoodie also has a small logo on the back that reads "Another Eye." The background of the image is predominantly white, with green accents that match the color of the eye's iris. There is a green heartbeat line that runs horizontally across the top of the image, adding to the theme of life or energy.
